description: For one tracked citizenship (ISO-2 code such as US, GB, DE): the comuni, provinces and regions where its holders concentrate, with counts and shares. It is CITIZENSHIP, not birthplace — foreign-born Italian citizens are not counted — and it carries small-number caveats: the comune ranking skips places under 1,000 residents by default and flags rows under 30 residents (`smallNumber`). A comune with no ISTAT row is left out, not counted as zero, so totals are floors. State those caveats when you quote a ranking; they are in the result's `caveats`. Province and comune lists are different levels of detail — say which.

cc.description: ISO-2 citizenship code of one of the citizenships this site tracks, e.g. "US".

limit.description: How many comuni and provinces to list, 1–50. Default 10.

minPopulation.description: Smallest comune, in residents, that may appear in the comune ranking. Default 1,000: in a village of sixty, four foreign residents is not a finding. Lowering it lets tiny places top the ranking.

rankBy.description: share: residents with this citizenship as a fraction of the comune's population. count: absolute numbers.
